<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="cli-reference">
<h1>CLI reference</h1>
<p>Readio’s CLI creates or resolves native <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdoc</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdbook</span></code> workspaces and dispatches each stage to its owning specialist package. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio</span> <span class="pre">--help</span></code> and command-specific help for the installed option set.</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>render-plan<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>run<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>speak<span class="w"> </span>--help
readio<span class="w"> </span>doctor<span class="w"> </span>--help
</pre></div>
</div>
<section id="native-workspace-workflows">
<h2>Native workspace workflows</h2>
<section id="create-and-plan">
<h3>Create and plan</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>article.docx<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc
readio<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc<span class="w"> </span>--language<span class="w"> </span>en-US
readio<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>novel.epub<span class="w"> </span>-o<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmdbook
readio<span class="w"> </span>plan<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmdbook<span class="w"> </span>--language<span class="w"> </span>en-US<span class="w"> </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">init</span></code> delegates conversion and bundle writing to SSMDConvert. It infers EPUB as a book and other supported inputs as documents unless <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--kind</span></code> is supplied. Outputs use the matching <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdoc</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.ssmdbook</span></code> suffix. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">plan</span></code> delegates compilation to UtterPlan; its planner options include language, diagnostics, text preparation, overlap/renderability policy, and optional spaCy controls.</p>
</section>
<section id="manual-specialist-workflow">
<h3>Manual specialist workflow</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>render-plan<span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narrator.renderprofile.toml<span class="w"> </span>--json
<span class="nv">VARIANT</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;&lt;exact variant returned by render-plan&gt;&quot;</span>
readio<span class="w"> </span>render<span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc<span class="w"> </span>--variant<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$VARIANT</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
readio<span class="w"> </span>compose<span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc<span class="w"> </span>--variant<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$VARIANT</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
readio<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">export</span><span class="w"> </span>article.ssmdoc<span class="w"> </span>--variant<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$VARIANT</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--output<span class="w"> </span>article.m4a
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render-plan</span></code> delegates profile-specific projection to UtterPlan and emits the specialist variant. When running stages manually, pass that exact variant unchanged to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compose</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">export</span></code>. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">render</span></code> delegates to VoiceRender; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">compose</span></code> to AudioCompose; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">export</span></code> to AudioExport. The export stage requires the optional AudioExport integration (install <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio[audioexport]</span></code>).</p>
</section>
<section id="run-the-complete-pipeline">
<h3>Run the complete pipeline</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>run<span class="w"> </span>article.docx<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narrator.renderprofile.toml<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--language<span class="w"> </span>en-US<span class="w"> </span>--json
readio<span class="w"> </span>run<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmdbook<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>novel.ssmdbook/narrator.renderprofile.toml<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--chapters<span class="w"> </span><span class="m">5</span>-17<span class="w"> </span>--language<span class="w"> </span>en-US<span class="w"> </span>--export<span class="w"> </span>--output<span class="w"> </span>novel.m4b
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">run</span></code> can accept source material or an existing workspace. It creates/resolves the native workspace, compiles, projects the RenderPlan, renders, and composes. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--export</span></code> adds the optional export stage. Readio forwards UtterPlan’s projected variant unchanged across all downstream calls. Stage-specific roots, policies, force flags, chapter selection, metadata, and encoder paths are forwarded to specialist APIs rather than reimplemented.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="voice-and-profile-management">
<h2>Voice and profile management</h2>
<p>These command groups delegate to VoiceRender:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">engines</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">models</span></code> discover, inspect, install, verify, and remove engine models.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voices</span></code> discovers voices; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span> <span class="pre">source</span></code> creates and inspects voice-source artifacts; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">voice</span> <span class="pre">clone</span></code> creates a specialist RenderProfile.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">profile</span></code> creates, inspects, validates, refreshes, and manages RenderProfile roles.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Use the command-specific <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--help</span></code> output for selectors and options. Install engine backends through VoiceRender extras, for example <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">python</span> <span class="pre">-m</span> <span class="pre">pip</span> <span class="pre">install</span> <span class="pre">&quot;voicerender[kokoro]&quot;</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="direct-speech">
<h2>Direct speech</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>speak<span class="w"> </span>--voice<span class="w"> </span>kokoro:v1.0/af_heart<span class="w"> </span>--lang<span class="w"> </span>en-US<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello.&quot;</span>
readio<span class="w"> </span>speak<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>narrator.renderprofile.toml<span class="w"> </span>--role<span class="w"> </span>narrator<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>--output<span class="w"> </span>greeting.wav<span class="w"> </span>--no-play<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Hello.&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">speak</span></code> synthesizes literal text through VoiceRender and plays by default. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--output</span></code> writes WAV and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-play</span></code> skips local playback. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--json</span></code> for a machine-readable result.</p>
</section>
<section id="dependency-diagnostics">
<h2>Dependency diagnostics</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>readio<span class="w"> </span>doctor
readio<span class="w"> </span>doctor<span class="w"> </span>--json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Doctor reports specialist package versions and VoiceRender engine availability. Progress is written to stderr; JSON results and structured errors are written to stdout. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--no-progress</span></code> disables progress callbacks on workflows that support them.</p>
</section>
<section id="removed-commands">
<h2>Removed commands</h2>
<p>The current CLI has no <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">config</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">audiobook</span></code>, or former generic project/plan/render-manifest command groups. Readio does not read a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio.toml</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.readio</span></code> state, and provides no migration path for its former project format. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">readio</span> <span class="pre">init</span></code> to create a new native workspace from source material, or use the specialist packages directly.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
